voice_text: This short video shows Aadi Spend O S in a phone sized browser. The native phone application is not part of this release, so this is the responsive web application, which adapts its layout to a narrow screen. We sign in as Rahul Sharma, the household owner.
subtitle_text: The web app on a phone
visual_instruction: Open the sign-in page on a phone viewport and sign in.

voice_text: The dashboard figures stack into one column, and the charts and lists follow below, readable without zooming. The menu moves into a drawer behind the menu button at the top left.

action: Open the menu and choose Add Expense.
voice_text: Opening the menu shows the same navigation as on a desktop, filtered by the signed in person s role. Choosing add expense closes the drawer and opens the form.
visual_instruction: Open the menu and choose Add Expense.

voice_text: The form uses large touch targets and the numeric keypad for amounts. We record one hundred and eighty rupees for vegetables paid in cash, and save. The goal in the product requirements is under fifteen seconds for a typical entry.
subtitle_text: Add an expense with a thumb

voice_text: The transactions list shows the new entry at the top. Wide tables scroll sideways on a phone. To be clear about scope: there is no native iOS or Android app yet, no offline mode, and no camera integration beyond the browser s file picker. Those are open decisions in the product requirements.
